name: Cessna 210 Centurion
summary: Fast six-seat high-wing single with retractable gear; most have a strutless cantilever wing, setting them apart from other high-wing Cessnas.

wings: High wing with no struts on 1967 and later models (cantilever)
Early 1960–66 models have a single lift strut
engines: Large six-cylinder engine in a deep cowling
fuselage: Retractable tricycle gear; main legs swing aft into the fuselage behind the cabin
Six-seat cabin; pressurized P210 has small rounded windows

tellTales: High-wing single with no wing struts
Clean belly in flight — gear retracts
Main gear folds back into the fuselage behind the cabin

confusedWith.howToTell: The 210 normally has no wing struts and retractable gear; the 182 has struts and fixed gear.
The 206 has wing struts, fixed gear and a double cargo door; the 210 has a clean strutless wing and retractable gear.
